verses.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. Clap your hands, all you peoples; shout unto God with a voice of triumph.

segments.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. Clap your hands, all you peoples; shout unto God with a voice of triumph.

verses.text: How awesome is the LORD Most High, the great King over all the earth!

segments.text: How awesome is the LORD Most High, the great King over all the earth!

verses.text: He subdues nations beneath us, and peoples under our feet.

segments.text: He subdues nations beneath us, and peoples under our feet.

verses.text: He chooses our inheritance for us, the pride of Jacob, whom He loves. Selah

segments.text: He chooses our inheritance for us, the pride of Jacob, whom He loves. Selah

verses.text: God has ascended amid shouts of joy, the LORD with the sound of the horn.

segments.text: God has ascended amid shouts of joy, the LORD with the sound of the horn.

verses.text: Sing praises to God, sing praises; sing praises to our King, sing praises!

segments.text: Sing praises to God, sing praises; sing praises to our King, sing praises!

verses.text: For God is King of all the earth; sing to Him a psalm of praise.

segments.text: For God is King of all the earth; sing to Him a psalm of praise.

verses.text: God reigns over the nations; God is seated on His holy throne.

segments.text: God reigns over the nations; God is seated on His holy throne.

verses.text: The nobles of the nations have assembled as the people of the God of Abraham; for the shields of the earth belong to God; He is highly exalted.
